purpose: Bounded city-specific registry/map source review for the WUP ranked settlement point; geometry-only where verified.
registryBasis: HM Land Registry publishes a Leeds City Council INSPIRE Index Polygons partition; geometry-only extraction verifies a registered-freehold extent polygon at the WUP point. This source provides indicative property extent, not complete parcel or exact legal-boundary coverage.

officialSources.observation: Official portal lists a Leeds City Council INSPIRE Index Polygons partition, published 2026-09-06.
National Data Library entry states Open Government Licence and authority-level delivery.
HMLR specification describes the polygons as indicative property extent for registered freeholds, not legal boundary definition.

searchQueries.query: Leeds INSPIRE index polygons HM Land Registry Leeds City Council authority file parcel geometry 2026
searchQueries.scope: Find current city-specific registration/map evidence and safe anonymous geometry routes.
searchQueries.result: The official HMLR portal publishes local-authority INSPIRE Index Polygons, with Leeds City Council as a downloadable partition. The 2026-09-06 file was fetched anonymously. Geometry-only parsing of 303,784 GML features found three complete polygons within 1 km of the exact WUP point: one containing it and two nearest neighbors at 10.433 m and 15.543 m. The official technical specification describes registered freehold extent polygons as indicative and not exact legal boundaries. Only GEOMETRY nodes were read; no feature attribute values were read or joined. Sample identifiers are 1-based GML member ordinals.
searchQueries.executionMethod: English-language web search plus direct inspection of public official/local source routes.
